market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have finished top 4 in 5 of the last 6 EPL seasons, possess a deep squad under Arne Slot, and face competition but remain one of the top three teams in England. Market-implied ~52% probability is well below their historical rate, creating value on Yes.
evidence_points: Liverpool missed top 4 only once since 2017-18 (5th in 2022-23).
Under Arne Slot in 2024-25 they secured a top-3 finish with a similar core.
Key rivals like Man United, Spurs, and Chelsea have greater inconsistency, leaving Liverpool a clear edge for a top-4 spot.
